chunks: As for the women past the age of bearing children, who have no hope of marriage, there is no harm if they take off their outer garments, but in such a way that they do not display their charms; yet if they avoid this it would be better for them. God is all-hearing and all-knowing.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for older women regarding their outer garments according to Surah An-Nur?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse is often interpreted as granting older women (al-kahilat) a concession to loosen their outer garments (jilbab) for comfort in private or familiar settings, distinct from the mandatory covering for younger women. The phrase 'provided they do not display their adornment' is understood to mean they may remove the jilbab but must still maintain modesty in their inner garments, avoiding excessive display of beauty. This ruling highlights the balance between ease in religious obligation and the enduring virtue of modesty (ist'faf) as a higher spiritual state.
